Jesus... I lost my savings on a betting app. My family has no idea.

He lost his savings on a betting app and hasn't told his family. He keeps thinking one more win will fix it.

Jesus: "Hiding it is costing you more than the money. It's costing you sleep, and peace, and you."

"Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper, but the one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy."
Proverbs 28:13 (NIV)

Stop chasing it back. Let Me walk you out.

youtube_description:
Jesus... I lost my savings on a betting app. My family has no idea.

He lost his savings on a betting app and hasn't told his family. He keeps thinking one more win will fix it.

Him: Jesus... I lost my savings on a betting app. My family has no idea. 😔

Him: I keep thinking one more win will fix it before anyone finds out.

Jesus: That thought is the trap. It's what lost the money in the first place.

Him: If my father finds out, he'll never trust me again.

Jesus: Hiding it is costing you more than the money. It's costing you sleep, and peace, and you.

Him: I don't know how to even start that conversation.

Jesus: Delete the app first. Then say one true sentence to him. I'll be in the room.

"Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper, but the one who confesses and renounces them finds mercy."
Proverbs 28:13 (NIV)

Jesus: Stop chasing it back. Let Me walk you out.
